about_the_game:
Xeno Conflict is a real-time strategic survival game based on a future background, where players can control different factions compete and cooperate with each other to fight against unknown biological environments. In the distant future, humans have been wandering in the interstellar space for thousands of years. In pursuit of stable survival resources, humans continue to explore unknown planets, but still find it difficult to find suitable living environments.

One day, a mysterious energy signal caught the attention of various factions. People turned their gaze to a remote planet, sensing that it may possess all the energy necessary for human survival. Taking this mysterious planet as a stage, the instinct for survival, unknown fear, and endless greed will collide fiercely here.

Mission Mode

Following the exploration perspectives of various factions, as a commander, you can choose to cooperate with different forces to explore every area of this planet together, facing the challenges of a large number of unknown creatures and ecological environments, attempting to uncover the unknown past of this planet, perhaps also the past of humanity.

Resource competition, target killing, battlefield defense, faction confrontation, a variety of targets and unexpected events in missions for you to explore.

Collaboration mode

You can operate different forces separately with your friends and collaborate to achieve more challenging goals.

Multiplayer battle mode

You can operate different faction forces with friends and engage in battles on different regions of the planet.Different regions have vastly different ecosystems and unknown risks, adding more uncertainty to the confrontation between factions.

Diverse monster mechanisms and environment

According to the ecological environment of different regions, you will encounter many monster ecosystems with different styles. Monsters and their environment form their own ecological systems, with diverse attack methods. There are various unknown relationships between different monsters waiting for you to explore.

Unique styles and abilities of different forces

Different forces has completely different architectural styles, combat units, skill abilities, and combat styles.

There is a mutual restraint relationship between different types of troops, combined with the rich attack methods of various monsters, requiring players to match and operate appropriately in order to survive in harsh survival environments.

Powerful Hero Units

Each faction's unique hero units can enter the exclusive nerolink mode, gaining more freedom in MOBA like operations and unleashing unique proprietary skills.

Properly operating powerful hero units may become the key to your victory in battle.
